item.text:
**Overall:** Lula’s 2024 record is mixed but leans positive on this lens. He repeatedly affirmed fiscal responsibility, approved spending cuts and a late-year fiscal package, and paired the central bank transition with formal autonomy language. The main counterevidence is not default or runaway inflation, but repeated market unease: high spending, fiscal-rule “tinkering,” and Lula’s public pressure on the central bank.

- [Responsabilidade fiscal é compromisso do governo e será mantida à risca, diz Lula](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/03/responsabilidade-fiscal-e-compromisso-do-governo-e-sera-mantida-a-risca-diz-lula.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-07-03 - Lula publicly pledged to keep fiscal responsibility “to the letter” and said the government would avoid economic shocks while still preserving transfers and growth. This is direct positive evidence for fiscal discipline and macro stability. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Brazil's Congress passes fiscal package, government plays down changes to the measures](https://theprint.in/world/brazils-congress-passes-fiscal-package-government-plays-down-changes-to-the-measures/2413876/) - Reuters via ThePrint - 2024-12-21 - Congress approved most of a government fiscal package designed to contain spending and put finances on a more sustainable path. That supports a claim that Lula’s administration pursued medium-term fiscal repair rather than pure short-term stimulus. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Congress changes to Brazil fiscal package not significant to savings estimate, says Haddad](https://www.tradingview.com/news/reuters.com%2C2024%3Anewsml_L1N3NL0M1%3A0-congress-changes-to-brazil-fiscal-package-not-significant-to-savings-estimate-says-haddad/) - Reuters via TradingView - 2024-12-20 - Haddad said congressional changes only slightly reduced projected savings and that the package was intended to preserve fiscal-rule sustainability. This is further evidence of an active fiscal-restoration effort, even though markets initially disliked the package. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Brazil's Lula says there is always room to cut spending](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-says-there-is-always-room-to-cut-spending-3500266) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-06-27 - Lula said spending cuts were possible and that his team was examining ineligible benefit payments, which suggests willingness to accept politically costly restraint. At the same time, the article shows he wanted to protect core social programs, so this is positive but not pure austerity evidence. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Lula says nothing is off the table in fiscal adjustment, but he won't act against the poor](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/06/18/lula-diz-que-nada-esta-descartado-no-ajuste-fiscal-mas-pede-apresentacao-de-necessidades-de-cortes.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-06-18 - Lula said the government was seriously studying budget cuts and that nothing was excluded from the adjustment discussion. This supports responsible fiscal management, though it also shows he was trying to balance consolidation with social protection. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Lula's nominee to head Brazil central bank emphasizes freedom in decisionmaking](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/lulas-nominee-to-head-brazil-central-bank-emphasizes-freedom-in-decisionmaking-3653485) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-10-08 - Gabriel Galípolo told senators that Lula had guaranteed him freedom in decision-making. That is direct evidence in favor of monetary credibility and institutional autonomy, even if markets still worried about political closeness. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.2

- [Brazil's real gains after dollar auctions, Lula's remarks on central bank](https://www.tradingview.com/news/reuters.com%2C2024%3Anewsml_L1N3NL0KD%3A0-brazil-s-real-gains-after-dollar-auctions-lula-s-remarks-on-central-bank/) - Reuters via TradingView - 2024-12-30 - Reuters reported that Lula explicitly promised the incoming central bank chief the “greatest autonomy” and that the remark helped calm markets after a fiscal scare. This is strong positive evidence that he recognized the need for monetary credibility and market reassurance. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.2

- [Brazil's economy seen growing steadily, fiscal deficit to stay high: Reuters poll](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-economy-seen-growing-steadily-fiscal-deficit-to-stay-high-reuters-poll-3528973) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-07-22 - The Reuters poll said Brazil could keep growing, but only alongside persistently uncomfortable deficits and a prior confidence crisis. This is the clearest negative evidence that Lula’s policy mix was not fully stabilizing fiscal expectations. Question IDs: 5B.3

- [Analysis-Brazil's tinkering to meet fiscal target threatens to dent credibility](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-09-18 - Reuters said the government was using increasingly creative accounting to hit targets, which raised expert doubts about the credibility of the new fiscal regime. This is the strongest counterevidence against a clean fiscal-responsibility score. Question IDs: 5B.3

- [Lula sends Congress calamity message to exclude RS reconstruction spending from fiscal result](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/05/06/lula-envia-ao-congresso-mensagem-de-calamidade-no-rs-para-excetuar-gastos-de-resultado-fiscal.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-05-06 - Lula sought an emergency exemption for Rio Grande do Sul reconstruction spending after the floods. This is not rent-seeking, but it does show willingness to loosen the fiscal scorecard for urgent political and disaster-response reasons. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Lula says Brazil will grow more than "they have talked about so far"](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/04/22/lula-diz-que-brasil-vai-crescer-mais-do-que-falaram-ate-agora.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-04-22 - Lula tied growth to credit expansion and public-bank financing, signaling a pro-growth, investment-friendly posture. The caveat is that this relied on demand support and credit, not just credibility-enhancing reforms. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Lula turns down Banco Central pressure, says new chief should look at Brazil, not market](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-07-01 - Lula said he would respect legal central-bank autonomy, but also argued the next chief should look at Brazil rather than “what the financial system says.” This is the key cautionary item: it suggests recurring political pressure on monetary credibility, even if not outright institutional capture. Question IDs: 5B.3, 5B.2

Search gap: I did not find evidence of a sovereign default scare, capital controls, or a collapse in inflation control. The main negatives were credibility erosion, market volatility, and higher spending pressures rather than a full macro breakdown.
